headline: Lithium Miners ETF Falls 2.75% While Albemarle Gains Following Earnings
summary: A lithium miners' exchange-traded fund fell 2.75% during a broad market sell-off. In contrast, Albemarle shares rose 3.58% following its earnings report.
why: Albemarle is a leading global lithium producer, making its financial results a key indicator for the electric vehicle battery supply chain.

impacts.name: Albemarle
impacts.why: Albemarle shares rose 3.58% after posting earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Positive company-specific earnings allowed Albemarle to defy a broader downward sector trend.
